stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (with CSS variable tokens)
stack.backend: None (mock/in-memory services via DataStore + localStorage demo state)
stack.database: In-memory DataStore singleton + localStorage (schema v2): identity seed only; business data grows from user actions
stack.infra: Vite dev server only (no external infra configured)

domains.name: Authentication & Access Control
domains.responsibility: Login entry points, session restore, and role-based route guards (ProtectedRoute/PlatformRoute/EmployeeRoute).

domains.name: Platform Admin Console
domains.responsibility: Super/admin workspace: organization management and Plans & Billing UI.

domains.name: Organization Workspace (Business Owner)
domains.responsibility: Org-level cockpit dashboard and finance tools (transactions, reports, logic learning).

domains.name: Team Member Workspace
domains.responsibility: Limited-access employee UI under EmployeeRoute guard.

critical_flows.name: Login -> session restore -> role-protected navigation
steps: User submits credentials to the appropriate login page; `AuthContext.login()` calls `authService.login()`.
On successful login, `AuthContext` stores `finance_os_token` in `localStorage` and applies the returned session (user/org/membership).
`AuthContext` derives `userRole` and loads organizations (platform roles load all orgs; org members load memberships).
Router guards in `src/app/App.tsx` (`ProtectedRoute` / `PlatformRoute` / `EmployeeRoute`) validate authentication + allowed roles and navigate to `authService.getRedirectPath()` when needed.
On refresh, `AuthContext` restores the session by reading `finance_os_token` and calling `authService.getSession(token)`.
protected_outcomes: Protected routes remain inaccessible to unauthenticated users.
Role-based routing lands users in the correct workspace (`/platform`, `/employee`, or `/dashboard`).
Organizations list is correct for platform admins/managers vs org members.

dependencies.reason: Implements login + session restore and provides redirect/role mapping inputs.
Loads organizations list for platform admins/managers.
Enforces role-based navigation to protected zones.

risks.description: Demo login ignores password contents and effectively authenticates by email (migration required before production).
Employee service uses isolated module-level seed arrays instead of the DataStore singleton, risking data drift and inconsistent updates.
Critical interactive flows appear incomplete (uncontrolled/unhandled form inputs; timer stop does not create a timesheet entry).
